name: Slice-by-Slice Ray Tracing
definition: An algorithm for efficient perspective volume rendering that inverts the typical ray-tracing loop to be driven by data currently in memory (slices/slabs) rather than by rays, thereby eliminating the need to store the entire volume dataset in RAM.
summary: Slice-by-slice ray tracing is a data-driven volume rendering algorithm that processes volume slabs to solve memory bottlenecks, distinguishing itself by performing explicit software ray marching rather than hardware-accelerated rasterization.
